fields.title: Hurricane Marlena Discussion Number 12
fields.office: NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL AL042026

sections.heading: DISCUSSION
sections.text: Satellite images show Marlena has a well-defined eye. The initial intensity is set at 85 kt, based on Air Force reconnaissance data. Warm water and low shear favor additional strengthening before landfall.

sections.heading: GUIDANCE
sections.text: The track models are tightly clustered and the forecast follows the consensus toward the northern Gulf coast. The risk of storm surge is high near and east of the center.
